rationale: Several papers directly investigate the discrepancy between weak lensing and CMB measurements, known as the $S_8$ tension, and its relation to the Hubble constant. Papers [2405.03627], [2504.14609], and [2310.07344] explore potential resolutions through modified cosmological models, while [2406.13479] suggests a natural explanation involving primordial gravitational waves. These contributions provide substantive new evidence but do not fully resolve the question.
